name: Travelers (personal insurance)
notes: Researched from public travelers.com pages only (no sign-in). Personal policies: Log in to MyTravelers to pay, set up AutoPay and view policy and bills; Make a one-time payment (view balance and pay) without logging in (review 2026-10-09: the public lookup form asks for billing account or policy number, last name on account and billing ZIP); Express Pay is the business-insurance guest option. Other options: mail to Travelers Personal Insurance, P.O. Box 660307, Dallas, TX 75266-0307; the automated phone number printed in the upper right of the bill (pay, due date, last payment received, info on cancellations, changes, refunds and returned checks); home banking bill pay. Paperless: log in to MyTravelers and choose the paperless option for all policies and bills. The public MyTravelers sign-in shows User ID and Password on one screen. Fees, cancellation and MFA are not documented publicly.

sources.title: Make a Payment: Find Billing Account or Policy

help.title: Pay your personal insurance bill
paragraphs: Log in to MyTravelers to pay your bill, set up AutoPay and view your policy and bills in one place.
Not registered? Use Make a one-time payment to look up your balance and pay without logging in. You need your billing account or policy number, the last name on the account and the billing ZIP code.
Other ways to pay include mail, the automated phone line printed on your bill, and your bank's online bill pay.

help.title: Mail, phone and home banking
paragraphs: Mail personal insurance payments to Travelers Personal Insurance, P.O. Box 660307, Dallas, TX 75266-0307.

Call the number in the upper right corner of your Travelers bill to check your due date, pay (posted the next business day), see the last payment received, and get information on cancellations, changes, refunds and returned checks.
You can also pay with your bank's online bill pay service if your bank offers it.

help.title: Enroll in AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay is set up in MyTravelers, alongside paying bills and viewing your policy. Sign in, open AutoPay and choose the payment account to enroll.

help.title: Go paperless
paragraphs: Log in to MyTravelers and choose the paperless option for all of your policies and bills. If you do not have an online account yet, create one first.
For billing accounts that go paperless for the first time, Travelers funds the planting or conservation of a tree through American Forests.

extra.intent: Using Travelers' other payment options page, find where on your Travelers bill the automated pay-by-phone number is printed. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: In the upper right-hand corner of the bill.

extra.intent: Find the P.O. Box number Travelers lists for mailing personal insurance payments. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
